basis.quote: I got into poison ivy while clearing brush on Saturday. Itchy blistery rash on both forearms, spreading a bit within that area.
basis.interpretation: Current confirmed contact dermatitis from poison ivy with active spreading rash and pruritus affecting both forearms; exposure occurred approximately 3-4 days before report.
No current respiratory symptoms or fever reported; baseline airway patency is maintained.

basis.quote: What if my tongue swells later? It is not swollen now and my breathing is normal.
basis.interpretation: Patient expresses concern about potential airway involvement but explicitly denies current tongue swelling and current respiratory difficulty.

output.reason: Active poison ivy dermatitis with spreading rash warrants clinician assessment for topical and systemic treatment options, but current airway and systemic toxicity are not present; this is time-sensitive remote review, not emergency.
